topics.topic: Which decided approval outcomes make a waiting element ready during recovery versus conclude the run
questions: Which decided approvals make the element ready during recovery, given that a refused approval concludes the run and an approved approval may already have produced a concluding NodeExecution?
Does “approval was decided” include a refused approval, even though A10 rule 3 says refusal writes `refused_by_owner` and ends the run `refused`?

Does “approval was decided” mean only an approved approval, or also a refused approval, which A10 rule 3 says has already written `refused_by_owner` and must end the run `refused` rather than make the element ready?
units: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner

quotes:
At start `runs` derives every run not ended with
  `run_graph`, which asks `effects.operation_element_conclusion` for each
  operation element: a wait that still holds stands, with its present reason;
  an element whose approval was decided, or whose attempt the owner resolved
  `not_applied`, is not reached and so is ready.

A `refused_by_owner` record ends its run `refused` whenever
  `runs` next derives the run, so a crash before `runs` writes the status sends
  nothing more: recovery derives `refused` before reaching any element.
judgement.why: The first passage makes every decided approval ready during recovery, while the second requires a refused decision to end the run before any element is reached.

topics.topic: How recovery derives run status and advancement when ready and waiting elements coexist
questions: When at least one element remains waiting but another element has become ready, does recovery derive the run as `running` and advance the ready element, or derive the status as `awaiting_approval`/`pending` because a wait remains and perform no advancement?

topics.topic: Whether a resolved not_applied attempt or an existing fresh requested approval controls recovery
questions: If recovery finds both a resolved `not_applied` attempt and the fresh `requested` approval that A11 rule 3 may already have recorded, does the existing `owner_approval` wait stand, or does the resolved attempt make the element ready to be reached again?
